label: Thomas Aquinas, Summa theologiae I q.3… supports OPEN reading of ST I q.3 a.5 ad 2: for…
note: tantum habet de esse, quantum ei appropinquat: as much of being as it approaches. The statement encodes this as an order match between a represented degree and nearness; the passage denies that God is a proportioned (homogeneous) measure, so representing being by a Preorder-valued degree is the analyst's (gap).
